chunks: And the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم said in his وصيّة to ʿAlī عليه السلام:
"O ʿAlī, hold fast to the siwak at the wudu (ablution) of every salat (prayer)."

key_terms.بِالسِّوَاكِ: with the toothstick used for cleaning the teeth
key_terms.عَلِيٍّ: Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام, the addressee of the instruction
key_terms.وُضُوءِ: wudu (ablution), the ritual washing before salat (prayer)

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم instruct Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام about using siwak before prayer?
ai.summary: This hadith records the Prophet's صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم instruction to Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام to use the siwak in connection with wudu (ablution) for every salat (prayer). It highlights oral cleanliness as a recommended practice associated with ritual preparation for worship.
